steps.en: Notice changes are picked up automatically every ten minutes
steps.id: Perubahan notice diambil otomatis setiap sepuluh menit

steps.en: Notice details are copied to the public-facing database
steps.id: Detail notice disalin ke database sisi publik

steps.en: Owner and hirer details are copied so their ID can be matched
steps.id: Data owner dan hirer disalin supaya ID-nya bisa dicocokkan

steps.en: The owner or hirer logs in and the portal knows their ID
steps.id: Owner atau hirer login dan portal mengenali ID-nya

steps.en: Notices where this person is the current offender are found
steps.id: Notice yang offender-nya orang ini dicari

steps.en: Notices are checked against stage and status rules before being shown
steps.id: Notice dicek terhadap aturan stage dan status sebelum ditampilkan
steps.why_en: Rules apply when the list is read, not when notices are sent, and stage lists differ across screens.
steps.why_id: Aturan diterapkan saat daftar dibaca, bukan saat notice dikirim, dan daftar stage berbeda antar layar.

steps.en: Eligible notices appear for the owner to furnish particulars
steps.id: Notice yang eligible muncul agar owner bisa mengisi particulars
